# Unicorner

> Unicorner is a free daily football (soccer) trivia game in the browser, at https://unicornergame.lol. Every day there are five football questions with 30 seconds each, and the twist is that obvious answers score least: the rarer your valid answer, the more points it is worth. No download and no sign-up needed to play. Available in English and Spanish.

## How it works

- A new game every day, the same five questions for everyone.
- Each question asks you to name one valid player, club, country, manager or stadium, for example "Name a country that has won the World Cup".
- You have 30 seconds per question.
- Scoring depends on how rare your answer is. The most obvious answers are a Tap-in (10 points), then Header (30), Volley (60), Bicycle kick (85), and the rarest valid answers are a Screamer (100 points).
- The highest possible score is 500.
- At the end you get your score and can share it, Wordle-style.

## Features

- Global leaderboard: a ranking for each day's game and a weekly ranking that resets every Monday; yesterday's winner is shown at the top. Signing in with an email and picking a nickname puts you on it.
- Private leagues: create a league, send the link to friends, and compare daily and weekly scores.
- Kits: 40 outfits for your pixel-art unicorn, unlocked by playing (games played, streaks, Screamers, high scores). The rarest, the Cosmic GOAT, is only for players who win a day.
- Streaks for playing on consecutive days.
- Infinity mode: endless practice with the same rules and no ranking (a short trial run is available now; the full version is coming soon).
- Retro pixel-art, arcade style.

## Good to know

- Free to play. No app to install; works on phone and desktop browsers.
- Often described as a "football Wordle" or a daily football quiz for people with real ball knowledge.
- Spanish version: https://unicornergame.lol/es/ (in Spanish the Screamer is called "Qué chicharro").
